business_problem: After moving to IBM z15, BRB still had limited high-platform monitoring and weak integration with low-platform processes, making it harder to automate operations and share reliable infrastructure-performance data.
solution_summary: BRB worked with IBM to modernize mainframe monitoring around IBM Tivoli Enterprise Portal, IBM OMEGAMON Data Provider and IBM Z Service Management Suite. The bank needed a way to observe z/OS, CICS, Db2, MQ, storage, network and Java components through one coherent reporting flow instead of a handful of isolated indicators. IBM's monitoring team helped configure the environment so performance and availability data from the high-platform estate could be exported into Elasticsearch and Grafana dashboards and shared more broadly with interested teams. Tivoli and OMEGAMON provide the collection and presentation layers, while Z Service Management Suite gives the bank a more centralized operational control point for critical IBM Z workloads. The resulting architecture connects mainframe telemetry to modern dashboarding and automation workflows, giving BRB a stronger basis for proactive monitoring, cross-platform coordination and secure service delivery across a large banking operation.

solution_components.name: IBM z15
solution_components.role: Hosts BRB's high-platform banking workloads that required improved observability after migration.

solution_components.name: IBM Tivoli Enterprise Portal
solution_components.role: Provides a monitoring and presentation layer for the bank's evolving mainframe observability workflow.

solution_components.name: IBM OMEGAMON Data Provider
solution_components.role: Collects operational data from the mainframe environment and exposes it to downstream dashboard tooling.

solution_components.name: IBM Z Service Management Suite
solution_components.role: Acts as the centralized management suite for monitoring and automating critical workloads on IBM Z.

data_flow: Operational metrics from z/OS, CICS, Db2, MQ, storage, network and Java components are collected by OMEGAMON, surfaced through Tivoli and Elasticsearch/Grafana dashboards, and used by BRB teams through the Z Service Management Suite for monitoring and automation.
business_outcome: BRB improved visibility into its mainframe estate, strengthened cross-platform operational management and created a more proactive monitoring posture for a banking environment serving millions of customers.
architecture_clues: The project linked mainframe telemetry to Elasticsearch and Grafana rather than keeping reporting only in legacy tools.
IBM teams provided installation and configuration support for the monitoring stack.
The rollout covered storage, network and Java components in addition to core transactional middleware.
